adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, the code calls `URI(request.referer || '').host` and only rescues `URI::InvalidURIError`. Ruby's URI parsing can also raise other exceptions (notably `ArgumentError`, e.g., from invalid/undefined byte sequences in the referer string/encoding), which would bypass the rescue and likely result in an unhandled 500 instead of the intended `Discourse::InvalidAccess` path.
